purpose: Read-only observations, not a performance qualification or comparison against the legacy game

environment.mode: arcade=cozy, actorSkin=arcade-bunny, combat live, input overlay active
environment.sharedEnvironment: Other repository verification was active during measurement

method.frameTiming: 120 consecutive requestAnimationFrame timestamp intervals per stage; median is the middle pair average, p95 is nearest rank
method.textureFilter: TextureManager keys containing arcade or cozy
method.textureBytes: Sum of source.width * source.height * 4 for each selected texture source; includes existing arcade-arena-floor, bunny atlases and blasters; excludes driver overhead, CPU Canvas duplication and unrelated legacy textures

allThreeStageArtCache.method: Calculated catalog upper bound: 3 floors + 9 distinct block material/dimension pairs + 4 shared props
